identity.note: the merchant key is the deployment's VERIFY_RECIPIENT; it is never committed

mainnet.note: fresh quotes are issued when the operator opens the monetisation door on mainnet; nothing here is a mainnet price

currency.amountRule: amountDem is the canonical DEM string accepted by demToOs(); amountOs is its integer base-unit value

quote.expiry: quotes do not expire; each 402 challenge is answered from the deployment's current price, and a proof whose amount is below that price is refused as mismatch
quote.retry: an identical request with the same payment proof is redelivered, never billed twice
quote.failure: a request that cannot yield a deliverable answers 400 before any challenge; a chain-read failure on the server during verification answers 503 with proofRetained: true so the same proof pays for the retry; a payment proof the node cannot verify is refused as 402 unverifiable and consumes nothing
quote.refund: none; an overpayment is accepted as paid

skus.title: DACS attestation-bundle verification
skus.deliverable: VerifyDocumentResult (pass, fail or indeterminate from the verifier rollup) plus a receipt {txHash, from, amountOs, resourceId}

limits.resourceIdBinding: sha256 of the exact request bytes

skus.fulfilment: automatic: POST /verify on the d402-gated verify endpoint (src/live/verify-endpoint.mts)

skus.title: Shared-suite interop run for one implementation adapter
skus.deliverable: runner JSON result, readable report, logs and blinded inputs, pinned to the Standard next head and every adapter commit; rows classed INTEROP-AGREE, IMPLEMENTATION-DIVERGENCE, SELF-CHECK or ADAPTER-DECLINED
skus.turnaround: one day from receiving the adapter command and commit
skus.fulfilment: manual: request on the working-group thread; report posted there or privately first

skus.title: @pathos-labs/dacs-verifier versioned package with licence and support entitlement
skus.deliverable: the packaged verifier (packages/verifier, MIT), its schemas, provenance.json and a support entitlement for that version

limits.support: issues on the repository for that version

skus.fulfilment: manual until the operator opens the package registry door (plan item s5-pkg-publish)
skus.status: builds; not yet on a registry

skus.title: Review-desk exact-head review of one standards PR revision
skus.deliverable: an executed exact-head review (validators, vectors and evaluator probes run at the head) posted on the PR with READ and EXECUTED separated
skus.fulfilment: manual: request review from the seat; the desk drafts, the gate reviews, the seat posts
skus.status: available; free to the DACS working group today

manualOrders.procedure: 1) the buyer asks for a quote on the service's channel naming scope; 2) the seat answers with a quote naming scope, acceptance criteria, delivery form, price and the merchant address; 3) the buyer pays that amount on Demos to the merchant address and posts the transaction hash on the channel; 4) delivery is posted on the channel and names the quote and the transaction hash; 5) acceptance is the buyer's reply, and a delivery that misses the quoted acceptance criteria is redone once at no charge
manualOrders.note: no endpoint enforces this today; it is the written procedure the seat follows
